reuse.why: Adds the #fixed rule to the existing getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions that every month-wide action already consults.

duplication.why: No logic duplicated; the existing hidden/template conditions are moved from SQL into the same helper's filter rather than copied.

placement.why: The rule lives in budget/actions.ts inside the single helper that defines which categories month-wide actions skip.

scope.why: One helper, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: A named tag regex and one filter are easy to follow; pulling every category row and filtering in JS rather than SQL is a minor trade-off.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No action applies the #fixed rule outside the shared skip set.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden/template conditions were moved within the same helper, not duplicated.

one_place.where: getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions (with FIXED_GROUP_TAG) in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and the average actions.
